result.summary: Overall the page looks like a well-formed food delivery home screen, but there are a few visual defects: truncated/clipped elements at screen edges, an empty partially-rendered category chip, and content colliding with the bottom navigation bar.

issues.description: The third card in 'Fastest near you' is clipped at the right screen edge and its title is cut mid-word ('Trattoria Piccol...') with no ellipsis, making it look broken rather than an intentional carousel peek.
issues.suggestion: Add proper text truncation with an ellipsis and adjust the horizontal padding/peek width so the card visibly reads as a scrollable carousel item.

issues.description: The last category filter chip after 'Healthy' is only partially visible as a thin sliver with no readable label, which looks like a rendering glitch.
issues.suggestion: Adjust chip spacing/peek amount so a meaningful portion of the next chip (with at least part of its label) is visible, or add a scroll affordance/fade at the edge.

issues.description: The bottom pizza card in 'Popular right now' is abruptly cut off by the bottom navigation bar, with the restaurant name and details entirely hidden.
issues.suggestion: Add bottom padding to the scrollable content equal to the nav bar height, or apply a subtle fade/scrim so cut-off content looks intentional while scrolling.

issues.description: Inconsistent metadata across cards: the 'Fastest near you' cards show delivery fee and time but no ratings, while 'Popular right now' cards show ratings — the pizza card also shows a '-20%' badge with no visible restaurant info.
issues.suggestion: Standardize the information shown on restaurant cards (time, fee, rating) across sections for a consistent, trustworthy appearance.

issues.description: The avatar in the top-right corner appears as an empty gray circle with only a small red notification dot, looking like a failed image load.
issues.suggestion: Provide a fallback avatar icon or user initials inside the circle so it doesn't appear as a broken/empty image.
